cohort: Sixty-two women undergoing caesarean section were randomized into two groups, one receiving tranexamic acid and one not.
finding: Tranexamic acid administration significantly reduced blood loss and the change in hemoglobin levels during and up to two hours after caesarean section, with no noted adverse side effects.
mod_finding: Tranexamic acid was found to reduce blood loss and hemoglobin change in women undergoing caesarean section.
